title: Compiled build identity
responsibility: Hashes a build’s paths and content identities, ignoring embedded stamp values so stamping does not change the build identity.

inputs.name: buildIdentity.files
inputs.description: Built files with forward-slash paths inside the build directory and SHA-256 content hashes; input order does not affect the result.

inputs.name: builtFileHash.bytes
inputs.description: Original bytes of one emitted file, optionally containing harness-build stamp slots.

outputs.name: buildIdentity
outputs.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest over each content hash and path in sorted path order.

outputs.name: builtFileHash
outputs.type: { sha256: string; stamps: string[]; slots: number }
outputs.description: SHA-256 of the bytes with all valid stamp slots emptied, all nonzero identities found in those slots, and the total slot count. Files without slots are hashed unchanged.
